Name: SMAPI Silent Launcher
Author: Yousv
Description:
[center][color=#b4a7d6][size=6][b]SMAPI Silent Launcher[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#d9d2e9]Starts SMAPI in a toggleable terminal window and adds a small overlay while the game loads. Press [b]Ctrl+F12[/b] to hide or show the terminal.[/color][/center]
[center][line]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48315/48315-1790325962-188873045.png[/img][/center]
[center][line]
[b][color=#b4a7d6][size=6]Features[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[list]
[*]Starts SMAPI in Windows Terminal when available, or a normal console window otherwise [color=#b4a7d6](only tested with Terminal)[/color].[/*]
[*]Shows a status overlay with mod and content pack counts, plus a live elapsed timer.[/*]
[*]Press [b][color=#ffffff]Ctrl+F12[/color][/b] to hide or show the SMAPI terminal at any time.[/*]
[*]Click the launch overlay to cancel the launch.[/*]
[*]Supports custom mod folder paths via [b][color=#ffffff]--mods-path[/color][/b] [color=#b4a7d6](defaults to Mods)[/color].[/*]
[*]No dependencies, no separate launcher files, single exe.[/*]
[*]Does not modify SMAPI, the game, or your mods.[/*]
[/list][line]
[center][b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b][/center]
[center]Windows. Requires Stardew Valley and SMAPI installed in the same folder.[/center]
[center]Requires Windows Terminal to work as intended.[/center]
[line]
[center][b][color=#ffffff][size=5]Installation[/size][/color][/b][/center]
Drop [b]SMAPI Silent Launcher.exe[/b] into your Stardew Valley folder, next to [b]StardewModdingAPI.exe[/b].

[b][color=#f6b26b][size=4]Steam[/size][/color][/b]
Go to Stardew Valley in your Steam library, right-click [b]Properties > General > Launch Options[/b] and set:
[code]"<GameDirectory>\SMAPI Silent Launcher.exe" --mods-path "mods" %command%[/code]Example:
[code]"D:\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\SMAPI Silent Launcher.exe" --mods-path "mods" %command%[/code]If your mods folder has a different name, replace [b]mods[/b] with that folder name.

[b]Shortcut / other launcher[/b]
Point it at [b]SMAPI Silent Launcher.exe[/b] and pass any arguments you normally use with SMAPI. They are forwarded to SMAPI. Use [b]--mods-path[/b] if your mods folder is not named [b]Mods[/b].
[line]
[center][color=#e06666][size=5][b]Antivirus Warnings[/b][/size][/color][/center]
Windows SmartScreen may warn you on first run because the exe is not code-signed. Choose [b]More info > Run anyway[/b] if you trust the download.
[line]
[center][b][color=#ffffff][size=5]Errors[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[b]"Wrong folder"[/b] - Move [b]SMAPI Silent Launcher.exe[/b] next to [b]Stardew Valley.exe[/b].
[b]"SMAPI is not installed"[/b] - Install SMAPI from [url=https://smapi.io]smapi.io[/url].
[b]"Already running"[/b] - Close the game, SMAPI, or another launcher instance first.
[b]"Could not register Ctrl+F12"[/b] - Close the other application using [b]Ctrl+F12[/b], then launch again.
[b]"SMAPI did not start"[/b] - Check that SMAPI is installed correctly, then try again.
[b]"SMAPI closed before the game started"[/b] - SMAPI exited during launch. Check the SMAPI log for the reason.
[b]"Launch aborted"[/b] - The launch was cancelled from the overlay.
